spans.s: + उदर्क शुभ- + उदर्क, adj., f. का, causing happiness,
सु-भाषित-रस-आस्वाद-जात-रोमाञ्च-कञ्चुक, adj. covered with a mail-like horripilation (a token of pleasure), produced by tasting the flavour of beautiful words,

+ भग सु- + भग,
 I. adj., f. गा. 1. fortunate,
= Rigv. i. 48, 7. 2. beautiful, Vikr. d. 123; lovely, Śāk. d. 3; charming, d. 57. 3. beloved, amiable,

.
 II. m. 1. the Aśoka tree. 2. the Champaca, Micelia campaka.
 III. f. गा. 1. a favourite woman. 2. a respectable mother. 3. the name of several plants.
 IV. n. fortune, Daśak. in
+ भट सु- + भट, m. a warrior (cf. भट्ट), Pañc. iii. d. 48.
+ भट्ट सु- + भट्ट, m.a very learned man, or perhaps rather a distinguished warrior,
(in the latter case read सुभट, see भट).

+ भद्र सु- + भद्र,
 I. adj. propitious, fortunate, Ṛt. 1, 17 v. r.
 II. m. Viṣṇu.
 III. f. रा, The sister of जगन्नाथ.
+ भर सु- + भर, adj. 1. heavily burthened. 2. heavy,
= Rigv. i. 112, 2 []. 3. f. रा, perhaps a proper name,

+ भाषित सु- + भाषित,
 I. adj. 1. well spoken. 2. and n. well discoursing. Pañc. 31, 4, ii. d. 177.
 II. n. 1. eloquence. 2. a good advice(?),
सुभिक्ष, i. e. सु-, n. abundance of food,
+ भीत सु- + भीत, adj. much afraid, Pañc. i. d. 20.
+ भृत सु- + भृत, adj. very lonely. ˚तम्, adv. 1. secretly,
+ भृश सु- + भृश, adj. much, exceeding. ˚शम्, adv. much, excessively.

सु-भ्रू,
 I. adj. having fine brows, Vikr. d. 13.
 II. and सु-भ्रु, f. a woman,
+ मानिन् सु-भग- + मानिन्, adj. fancying one's self fortunate, Daśak. in
+ लग्न शुभ- + लग्न, m. (?), an auspicious moment,
1. शुभ् शुभ् (probably for original श्वभ्, cf. शुध्; see also शुम्भ्, s. v. 2. शुभ्), i. 1, Ātm., i. 6,

. To be gay or happy, Pañc. iii. d. 226.
 5. † To hurt, to kill Ved. infin. शुभे, []

= Rigv. i. 64, 4.
 --Caus. शोभय, To cause to shine, to adorn,

= Rigv. i. 85, 3.
 शोभित, Trimmed, Hit. iii. d. 27.
 --With the prep. उप उप, To shine, Pañc. i. d. 85.
 --Caus. To adorn,

; Pañc. 159, 20.
 --With वि वि, To shine, Hit. ii. d. 71.
 --With सम् सम्, Caus. To adorn, Ṛt. 6, 23.
† 2. शुभ् शुभ्, शुम्भ् शुम्भ्, सुभ् सुभ्, सुम्भ् सुम्भ्, i. 1,

. To speak, to shine.
 2. To kill, to hurt.

शुभ् + अ,
 I. adj., f. भा.
 1. Splendid,

. ed. 72, 5; beautiful, Pañc. iii. d. 185. Comparat. शुभतर, Very beautiful, Pañc. 226, 5.
 2. Distinguished,

. Happy, Hit. i. d. 5, M.M.; good, Pañc. iii. d. 106; virtuous, i. d. 150.
 II. m. One of the astrological Yogas.
 III. f. भा.
 1. A female friend of the goddess Umā,

. Bambu manna.
 3. Bent grass.
 IV. n. Happiness, hail,
शुभाशुभ, i. e. शुभ-अ-शुभ, adj. good or wicked, Pañc. ii. d. 18.
शुभंभावुक, i. e. शुभ + म्-भू + उक, adj. Resplendent,
शुभंयु, i. e. शुभ + म् + यु, adj. Happy, prosperous,

= Rigv. i. 85, 3; Pañc. i. d. 252.
 II. m.
 1. White (the colour).
 2. Sandal,
शुभ्र + त्व, n. Whiteness, Böhtl. Ind.
सु-भाषित + मय, i. e. (vb. भाष्), + मय, adj. Consisting in fine speeches, Pañc. ii. d. 176.
